messages:
Ravi Shah: Customer 'gamma-inc' reported SSO failures this morning. Auth logs show token audience checks failing and scim provisioning returning 409 duplicates. Posting snippets.

Nora Lin: paste the logs?

Ravi Shah: auth-proxy:
```
2026-03-25T07:05:12Z ERROR auth-proxy: verify_token failed tenant=gamma-inc err=aud_mismatch expected=client-123 actual=https://idp.gamma-inc.com
```

and scim-provisioner:
```
2026-03-25T07:06:00Z WARN scim-provisioner: create user failed status=409 externalId='GAM-9001\n'
2026-03-25T07:06:01Z ERROR scim-provisioner: webhook verify: decrypt error: encryption_context_mismatch (tenant=gamma.inc vs gamma-inc)
```

Omar Ruiz: looks like two separate mismatches: aud vs client id (OIDC) and KMS encryption context canonicalization (dot vs dash). Did we do any recent secret rotations?

ci-bot: deploy services/secret-rotate@2026-03-24T23:50 UTC succeeded (hash: b7c8f)

Nora Lin: we did a tenant canonicalization change in the scim consumer on 2026-03-24 to normalize dots to underscores for internal keys. That would change the encryption context we send to KMS. If the SCIM agent still encrypts using the old tenant id with dashes, decrypt fails.

Ravi Shah: the aud mismatch could be caused by templating too: our SSO_AUDIENCE env var may have been replaced with the IDP issuer during secret-rotate. If our code is checking aud==client_id but env is issuer, that'll fail.

Omar Ruiz: quick remediation checklist: 1) rollback tenant canonicalization in scim-consumer and accept multiple canonical forms when calling KMS 2) revert SSO_AUDIENCE substitution and use CLIENT_ID for audience validation 3) add trimming/lowercasing on externalId to avoid trailing-space duplicates 4) requeue failed scim jobs with dedupe on normalized id

Nora Lin: I'll push a hotfix to accept both gamma-inc and gamma.inc as encryption contexts when calling Decrypt (tolerant resolver). Also adding a one-off script that maps existing encrypted payload contexts to the new canonical form so requeues succeed.

Ravi Shah: ran a local introspect test after changing auth-proxy to validate against CLIENT_ID and it returned active:true. I'll schedule a hotfix deploy for prod auth-proxy.

ops-bot: hotfix deploy auth-proxy@2026-03-25T08:12 UTC succeeded (hash: c3d4e)

Omar Ruiz: requeued 14 failed scim ops for gamma-inc with normalization applied: 11 succeeded, 3 still 409 (those have identical normalized ids). I'm hand-reviewing merge candidates.

Nora Lin: filed PR to add normalization helpers + unit tests and a feature flag to revert if any tenant breaks. Also writing runbook entry on KMS EncryptionContext rules (tenant canonicalization policy).

security-bot: created ticket VULN-2026-118 (low) to track templating substitution risk for SSO_AUDIENCE; assigned to Nora Lin.

Ravi Shah: customer confirmed SSO now works and provisioning mostly recovered. Follow-ups: Nora add CI test for secret-rotate that validates SSO_AUDIENCE != IDP_ISSUER, Omar add alert for Decrypt errors due to encryption_context_mismatch, and ops to run a one-time audit for tenants with multiple canonical forms.

Omar Ruiz: on it. will also add a dashboard showing scim 409 rate by tenant.

Ravi Shah: thanks team, will write a short blameless postmortem tomorrow and attach steps taken. :thumbsup:
